# Generated by tools/regen_greys_psc.py on 2026-08-27. Do not hand-edit: the next
# run overwrites this file. Change the generator instead.
#
# Load order: TGR -> PSC -> KAI -> E&F -> ... -> megapack -> [VC] -> ... -> Grey's pack -> THIS.
# Why this file exists: see the body -- a path override is the only way to cancel another mod's additive history block.

# This file deliberately has no BUILDINGS block: it exists to shadow, by path,
# grey_usu/common/history/buildings/MoG_consec_balancer.txt.
#
# USU's version hands +1 construction sector at game start to every incorporated,
# non-treaty-port state with iron potential, to compensate for ITS OWN sectors being
# 2/5 of vanilla size. With PSC's model restored (see the other files here) that
# compensation is for a shrink that never happened: a PSC sector is a full goods
# factory (1000 pops and 100 construction cost per level), PSC already places the
# starting sectors it wants in its own common/history/buildings/PSC_buildings.txt,
# and history containers are additive -- there is no prefix that can cancel another
# mod's BUILDINGS block, only a file at the same path.
#
# !! MAINTENANCE !! this override also swallows anything the Grey's author adds to
# this file later. Re-read it on every Grey's update.
#
# USU's mog_construction_max_level_adjustment modifier is deliberately NOT touched:
# with has_max_level = no on the sector it has nothing to cap and does nothing.
